what: It trades recyclable materials, mainly waste paper and scrap metal, from Japan to buyers across East and Southeast Asia.
proceeds: It plans to spend 30% on expanding into new markets, 20% on an AI trading system and 20% on facilities and environmental certification. It plans 15% for new recyclable products and 15% for working capital and reserves.
risks: Past financial results do not guarantee future results, which can change for reasons the company cannot predict.
The company must keep improving its trading matching system, and its plans to add AI may fail or become outdated.
It relies on suppliers for all its products, mostly buys deal by deal without long-term contracts, and could be hurt if those relationships weaken.
Its sales depend on consumer demand and spending in Japan and Asia, which factors outside its control can reduce.
It relies on a few major suppliers and customers, so losing any of them could seriously harm its business.
